---
title: "Reading Statistics"
toc: false
---

::: {.stats-intro}

An overview of my reading activity, from individual reading sessions to longer-term trends.

:::

```{r}
#| include: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)

source("R/reading_helpers.R")

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Import datasets
# --------------------------------------------------

books <- read_csv(
  "data/books.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    date_started = as.Date(date_started),
    date_finished = as.Date(date_finished)
  )

reading_log <- read_csv(
  "data/reading_log.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    book_id = col_character(),
    date = col_date(),
    page_reached = col_integer()
  )
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Calculate daily reading
# --------------------------------------------------

book_progress <- calculate_book_progress(
  books,
  reading_log
)

if (nrow(book_progress) > 0) {

  daily_totals <- book_progress |>
    group_by(date) |>
    summarise(
      pages_read = if (anyNA(pages_read)) {
        NA_integer_
      } else {
        sum(pages_read)
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  daily_reading <- daily_totals |>
    complete(
      date = seq.Date(
        min(daily_totals$date),
        max(daily_totals$date),
        by = "day"
      ),
      fill = list(pages_read = 0L)
    ) |>
    arrange(date)

} else {

  daily_reading <- tibble(
    date = as.Date(character()),
    pages_read = integer()
  )

}

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Summary statistics
# --------------------------------------------------

books_reading <- sum(
  books$status == "Reading",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

books_finished <- sum(
  books$status == "Finished",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

completed_pages <- books |>
  filter(
    status == "Finished",
    !is.na(total_pages)
  ) |>
  summarise(
    total = sum(total_pages),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pull(total)

pages_logged <- sum(
  daily_reading$pages_read,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

reading_days <- sum(
  daily_reading$pages_read > 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

calendar_days <- nrow(daily_reading)

average_daily <- if (calendar_days > 0) {
  round(pages_logged / calendar_days, 1)
} else {
  NA_real_
}

average_reading_day <- if (reading_days > 0) {
  round(pages_logged / reading_days, 1)
} else {
  NA_real_
}

format_metric <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) {
    return("—")
  }

  format(
    x,
    big.mark = ",",
    trim = TRUE,
    scientific = FALSE
  )
}

average_daily_display <- format_metric(
  average_daily
)

average_reading_day_display <- format_metric(
  average_reading_day
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Recent daily activity
# --------------------------------------------------

recent_reading <- if (nrow(daily_reading) > 0) {

  daily_reading |>
    filter(
      date >= max(date) - 29
    )

} else {

  daily_reading

}

date_breaks <- if (nrow(recent_reading) == 0) {

  as.Date(character())

} else if (nrow(recent_reading) <= 7) {

  recent_reading$date

} else {

  seq.Date(
    from = min(recent_reading$date),
    to = max(recent_reading$date),
    by = "1 week"
  )

}

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Monthly activity
# --------------------------------------------------

recorded_dates <- c(
  reading_log$date,
  books$date_finished
)

recorded_dates <- recorded_dates[
  !is.na(recorded_dates)
]

month_sequence <- if (length(recorded_dates) > 0) {

  seq.Date(
    from = lubridate::floor_date(
      min(recorded_dates),
      "month"
    ),
    to = lubridate::floor_date(
      max(recorded_dates),
      "month"
    ),
    by = "month"
  ) |>
    tail(12)

} else {

  as.Date(character())

}

month_breaks <- if (length(month_sequence) > 0) {

  unique(c(
    month_sequence[
      seq(
        1,
        length(month_sequence),
        by = if (
          length(month_sequence) > 6
        ) 2 else 1
      )
    ],
    tail(month_sequence, 1)
  ))

} else {

  as.Date(character())

}

# Monthly pages recorded
monthly_reading <- tibble(
  month = month_sequence
) |>
  left_join(
    daily_reading |>
      mutate(
        month = lubridate::floor_date(
          date,
          "month"
        )
      ) |>
      group_by(month) |>
      summarise(
        pages_read = sum(
          pages_read,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "month"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pages_read = replace_na(
      pages_read,
      0L
    )
  )

# Books completed each month
completed_by_month <- tibble(
  month = month_sequence
) |>
  left_join(
    books |>
      filter(
        status == "Finished",
        !is.na(date_finished)
      ) |>
      mutate(
        month = lubridate::floor_date(
          date_finished,
          "month"
        )
      ) |>
      count(
        month,
        name = "books_finished"
      ),
    by = "month"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    books_finished = replace_na(
      books_finished,
      0L
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Shared chart styling
# --------------------------------------------------

stats_palette <- function(dark = FALSE) {

  if (dark) {

    list(
      background = "#181d1b",
      text = "#f0efe9",
      muted = "#b2bbb3",
      grid = "#39443c",
      accent = "#a8c1aa"
    )

  } else {

    list(
      background = "#f8f6f2",
      text = "#2d342f",
      muted = "#657069",
      grid = "#e5dfd6",
      accent = "#4f6b59"
    )

  }

}

stats_theme <- function(dark = FALSE) {

  palette <- stats_palette(dark)

  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 12,
    base_family = "sans"
  ) +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(
        fill = palette$background,
        color = NA
      ),

      panel.background = element_rect(
        fill = palette$background,
        color = NA
      ),

      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),

      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
        color = palette$grid,
        linewidth = 0.4
      ),

      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      axis.text = element_text(
        color = palette$muted,
        size = 10
      ),

      axis.title.y = element_text(
        color = palette$text,
        size = 11,
        margin = margin(r = 12)
      ),

      axis.title.x = element_blank(),

      plot.margin = margin(
        t = 12,
        r = 18,
        b = 12,
        l = 8
      )
    )

}

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Reusable plotting functions
# --------------------------------------------------

plot_daily_reading <- function(dark = FALSE) {

  if (nrow(recent_reading) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  palette <- stats_palette(dark)

  ggplot(
    recent_reading,
    aes(x = date, y = pages_read)
  ) +
    geom_col(
      fill = palette$accent,
      width = 0.72
    ) +
    scale_x_date(
      breaks = date_breaks,
      date_labels = "%b %d"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 4),
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(0, 0.13)
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Pages read"
    ) +
    stats_theme(dark)

}

plot_monthly_reading <- function(dark = FALSE) {

  if (nrow(monthly_reading) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  palette <- stats_palette(dark)

  ggplot(
    monthly_reading,
    aes(x = month, y = pages_read)
  ) +
    geom_col(
      fill = palette$accent,
      width = 20
    ) +
    scale_x_date(
      breaks = month_breaks,
      date_labels = "%b %Y",
      expand = expansion(
        add = c(17, 17)
      )
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 4),
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(0, 0.13)
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Pages logged"
    ) +
    stats_theme(dark) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 25,
        hjust = 1
      )
    )

}

plot_monthly_completions <- function(dark = FALSE) {

  if (nrow(completed_by_month) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  palette <- stats_palette(dark)

  max_completed <- max(
    1L,
    completed_by_month$books_finished,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  ggplot(
    completed_by_month,
    aes(x = month, y = books_finished)
  ) +
    geom_col(
      fill = palette$accent,
      width = 20
    ) +
    scale_x_date(
      breaks = month_breaks,
      date_labels = "%b %Y",
      expand = expansion(
        add = c(17, 17)
      )
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq.int(
        0L,
        max_completed
      ),
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(0, 0.15)
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Books completed"
    ) +
    stats_theme(dark) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 25,
        hjust = 1
      )
    )

}

# Show a helpful message when no data exists
show_stats_plot <- function(plot) {

  if (is.null(plot)) {

    cat(
      '<p class="stats-empty">',
      'No records are available for this chart.',
      '</p>'
    )

  } else {

    print(plot)

  }

}
```

::: {.stats-note}

Daily averages are calculated from the first to the latest recorded reading date. Dates without entries are treated as zero for these calculations, although an unlogged day does not necessarily mean no reading occurred.

Completed-book page counts and daily page logs are separate measures and should not be added together.

:::

## Recent Reading Activity

Pages recorded each day within the most recent 30 days of available reading history.

::: {.stats-chart .stats-chart--light}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 3.3
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-alt: "Daily pages logged during the most recent available reading period."

show_stats_plot(
  plot_daily_reading(dark = FALSE)
)
```

:::
